testcase.name: a log without a usable id is left to the host seed
seedFromLog keeps the seeded flag so a rotation or the host cannot overwrite the edit
the saved meal travels with the draft so the save keeps its notes and untouched foods
after clearDraft the next open seeds again, as a new meal or as another edit
every real change makes the edit dirty and undoing it makes it unchanged again
an edit is never persisted so a restored holder cannot save over the original meal
text typed before the first seed is not replaced by the log
seedFromLog sets the editing id, the draft id, the day, the meal and one decided card per food
a restored draft is never seeded from a log
a draft for a new meal is never an unchanged edit
a draft that was already seeded for a new meal is not turned into an edit
a new meal after an edit is persisted again with its own draft id
an edit that changed nothing is unchanged and expanding a card does not change it
a log without a date edits on today
clearDraft ends the edit and gives the next draft a new id
